title: GRANULAR (Digitone insert)
author: analoglav
description: Experimental stereo 2-pitch granular insert only (+5 and +12 semitones, two overlapping grains per pitch). No custom delay or reverb: original Digitone FM, Delay and Reverb remain functional before the insert. Mod Menu GRANULAR toggles. AUTO-channel MIDI CC60 controls dry/wet MIX. Fixed point, 32 stereo frames/block, ~128 KiB ring buffer. Core-dn1 >= 4.1 required.
